text: Human Rights Watch said the ATP's 2024 partnership with Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, under which PIF became the official naming partner of the ATP Rankings, was one of two tennis deals that effectively enabled the Saudi government's efforts to sportswash its human rights record, and called for the tennis body to press Saudi Arabia to release jailed rights activists.

source.name: Human Rights Watch, "Saudi Arabia: Global Tennis 'Sportswashes' Abuses"
source.quote: have effectively enabled the Saudi government's efforts to "sportswash" its egregious human rights record through the announcement of two separate deals with Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF)
